description: Big Five (OCEAN) personality knowledge base for GENESIS RAG system

overview.name: Big Five / Five-Factor Model (FFM) / OCEAN
overview.description: The most widely accepted and scientifically validated personality framework
overview.scoring: Each dimension is a spectrum from low (0) to high (100), not binary categories
overview.note: All positions on each spectrum are valid - there is no 'ideal' personality

openness.description: Reflects imagination, creativity, and interest in new ideas and experiences

facets.emotionality: Awareness and value of inner feelings
facets.intellect: Interest in abstract ideas and intellectual curiosity
facets.liberalism: Openness to reevaluating values and authority

highO.approach: Engage their curiosity and imagination freely

lowO.approach: Be concrete and practical, respect their preferences

conscientiousness.description: Reflects organization, dependability, self-discipline, and goal-directed behavior

facets.selfEfficacy: Confidence in one's ability to accomplish things
facets.dutifulness: Sense of duty and moral obligation
facets.selfDiscipline: Ability to begin and complete tasks

highC.approach: Be organized and reliable, respect their standards

lowC.approach: Be flexible, don't pressure with structure

extraversion.description: Reflects energy, positive emotions, sociability, and tendency to seek stimulation

facets.friendliness: Interest in and warmth toward others
facets.assertiveness: Tendency to take charge and lead
facets.activityLevel: Pace of living and energy level

highE.approach: Be energetic and engaging, match their enthusiasm

lowE.approach: Give space, don't overwhelm with energy

agreeableness.description: Reflects cooperation, trust, altruism, and concern for social harmony

facets.trust: Belief in others' sincerity and good intentions
facets.sympathy: Concern and care for others' feelings

highA.approach: Be warm and harmonious, validate their care for others

lowA.approach: Be direct and objective, don't be overly sentimental

neuroticism.description: Reflects tendency to experience negative emotions like anxiety, anger, and depression

facets.anxiety: Tendency to worry and feel apprehensive
facets.anger: Tendency to feel frustration and irritability
facets.depression: Tendency to feel sad, hopeless, or lonely

highN.approach: Be extra gentle, validate feelings, provide reassurance

lowN.approach: Be straightforward, they can handle directness

combinations.description: Common personality profiles based on trait combinations

analyst.pattern: High O, High C, Low E, Low A, Low N
analyst.description: Curious, organized, independent thinkers who excel at complex problems

advocate.pattern: High O, Low C, High E, High A, High N
advocate.description: Passionate idealists who care deeply about causes and people
advocate.lunaApproach: Support their vision, help manage emotional intensity

executive.pattern: Low O, High C, High E, Low A, Low N
executive.description: Practical, organized leaders who get things done
executive.lunaApproach: Be practical and efficient, respect their standards

caregiver.pattern: Low O, High C, Low E, High A, High N
caregiver.description: Reliable, nurturing individuals who support others quietly
caregiver.lunaApproach: Be warm and appreciative, don't overlook their needs

adventurer.pattern: High O, Low C, High E, High A, Low N
adventurer.description: Spontaneous, warm individuals who embrace new experiences
adventurer.lunaApproach: Be fun and open, go with their flow

correlations.wellbeing: High E, Low N, High A, High C correlate with life satisfaction
correlations.creativity: High O is the strongest predictor of creative achievement
correlations.leadership: High E, High C, Low N predict leadership emergence
correlations.relationships: High A and Low N predict relationship satisfaction
correlations.longevity: High C is linked to longer lifespan and healthier behaviors

development.agingEffects: A and C tend to increase with age; N tends to decrease
development.stability: Traits become more stable after age 30 but can still change
development.interventions: Therapy and intentional effort can shift traits moderately

enneagram.note: Enneagram provides motivational depth; Big 5 provides behavioral breadth
enneagram.example: An Enneagram 4 (Individualist) might be High O, High N, Low E

bazi.note: BaZi provides elemental constitution; Big 5 provides psychological traits
bazi.example: Yang Fire Day Master often correlates with High E, High O
